title: Evidence Hydrology: from bounded lake to inland sea
purpose: Build a continuously refreshed, provenance-preserving evidence sea fed by broad discovery oceans, recurring authoritative freshwater streams, direct-voice tributaries, and archival or restricted aquifers without allowing source volume to promote a claim.

ocean_discovery.function: High-recall discovery across web, scholarly, corporate, news, archive, graph, and bulk-data corpora.
ocean_discovery.risk: Volume, duplication, derivative reporting, ranking bias, stale copies, and false joins.

freshwater_authoritative.function: Recurring primary, official, adjudicative, regulatory, procurement, filing, audit, and standards streams.
freshwater_authoritative.risk: Official custody does not guarantee completeness, neutrality, practical effect, or subject standing.

tributary_direct_voice.function: Direct affected-person, worker, operator, family, community, defense, plaintiff, and witness evidence.
tributary_direct_voice.risk: Voice is deployment-specific and cannot be imported into adjacent systems; privacy and consent govern acquisition.

aquifer_archival_or_restricted.function: Slow, deep records obtained through archives, FOIA, discovery, dockets, contract appendices, internal logs, decommission files, and restricted collections.
aquifer_archival_or_restricted.risk: Restricted access, redaction, selection effects, legal duties, privacy, and incomplete custody.

estuary_rule.description: A candidate reaches the estuary only when at least two independently governed hydrology classes converge on the same exact entity, deployment, instrument, date, threshold, consequence, right, or remedy.

storage_law.default: Store locators, request metadata, response headers, hashes, extracted public metadata, and bounded excerpts; do not warehouse copyrighted or sensitive full text by default.
storage_law.direct_voice: Store only consented, public, or lawfully obtained material; prefer deidentification and source pointers over bulk copying.
storage_law.restricted: Never automate access around authentication, rate limits, robots controls, legal restrictions, or confidentiality duties.
storage_law.deletion: Preserve tombstone metadata and prior hashes when a public source disappears, while honoring legal deletion duties for protected data.
